summary: Describes how the MIT Lincoln Laboratory IBM 360/67 let other ARPANET users log in and use it. After logging in, a user got a whole virtual 360 machine with a virtual console, card reader, printer and disks. The document is a description of one site's service rather than a general standard.

eli5.summary: One big computer pretends to be many small computers, one for each visitor. This note explains how a faraway visitor could knock on the door and get their own pretend computer.
